Ubuntu / DebianDEB package · 23.1 MB FedoraRPM package · 25.5 MB AppImagePortable application · 64.7 MB Portable archiveTAR.GZ · 69.4 MB

DEB: Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 and Debian 12. RPM: Fedora 43. Portable packages are also available.

Direct downloads from the project's official GitHub release. Windows is not Authenticode-signed. macOS builds are ad-hoc signed, without Apple notarization. Corresponding macOS sources and verification reports are included on the release page.

Choose the right tool for you.

Verify independently

Core downloads and validates the blockchain. Allow time and disk space for the initial synchronization.

Use the built-in wallet

Manage your addresses and CONN from the same application that runs your node.

Mine or claim

Use the optional CPU miner or Automatic Claims to participate in the network. Rewards depend on network conditions and available bounties.

Looking for a wallet without a full-node setup? Try Connect Wallet. For a terminal-only claims client, see claimer.
